::: {.event data-label="570CE - 621CE" }
**MECCA**
:::

::: {.event data-label="570CE - 621CE" .text-start}
**570CE: Birth of Prophet Muhammad (SM)** Born in Mecca.
:::

::: {.event data-label="570CE - 621CE" .text-start}
**610CE: First Revelation** At the age of 40 years old received first revelation in Cave of Hira, Mecca.
:::

::: {.event data-label="622CE - 632CE" }
**MEDINA**
:::




::: {.event data-label="622CE - 632CE" .text-start}
**622CE: Hijra (Migration)** At the age of 52 years old migrated from Mecca to Medina.
:::

::: {.event data-label="622CE - 632CE" .text-start}

**632CE: Death** At the age of 63 years old died in     house of his wife Aisha, near the mosque in Medina (Al-Masjid an-Nabawi) in Medina.
:::

::: {.event data-label="622CE - 632CE" .text-start}
